title: REPORT on public procurement
part_text: Hg. whereas in its resolution of 13 March 2025 the European Parliament urged the Commission, in the context of the forthcoming revision of Directive 2014/24/EU, to further promote collective bargaining, the use of the social clause, and preferential treatment for companies whose workers are covered by collective agreements; whereas it underlined that contracting authorities must exclude from public tenders economic operators that have engaged in criminal activities;
